Staff only: the casino's back of house
Two to count · two to sign
Every night's drop boxes come here from the tables. Two clerks count every chip by colour, a second time to be sure, and both sign the sheet before it goes into the vault.
Every table, machine and door on the floor has a camera, and the screens here never sleep. When a big win comes up, or a dispute at a table, the officer pulls the recording for the pit boss.
Lockers for every post, the kettle, a sofa and the notice board: the rota, the house rules, and who has the next night off.
The casino manager's desk, the safe for the night's float, the books. Hiring, promotions and raises for the Hidden Crescent's staff are decided here.
Tables, wheels and machines on the floor

opens to a Hidden Crescent staff badge. Every post here is hired the same way as in the city: look for 📋 Hiring here , or ask the casino manager by the airlock.

Where everything is Pick a place and the banner at the top points the way.

Pass line: 7 or 11 on the first roll wins, 2, 3 or 12 loses; any other number is the point, and you win if it comes again before a 7. Don't pass is the reverse (12 on the first roll is a stand-off). The field , one roll: 3, 4, 9, 10 or 11 pay even money, 2 pays double, 12 pays triple. Any seven , one roll, pays 4 to 1.
The stickman waves the bet away.
A stand-off: your chips come back.
The stickman rakes your chips in.

The hand nearer 9 wins; the cards are drawn by the house rules, not by you. Player pays even money, banker pays 19 to 20, a tie pays 8 to 1 (and hands player and banker bets back). Smallest bet in the Salon: 100 chips.
The Salon's smallest bet is 100 chips.
The dealer slides the cards from the shoe…
The dealer waves the bet away.
Put your chips on a number and the wheel is spun. It pays what the number says: 1 to 1, 2 to 1, 5, 10, 20, and 40 to 1 on the crescent. Of the 54 places, 25 are ones and only one is the crescent.
The attendant waves the bet away.
Suits on the rack by the door
Three moons pay 200 to 1; three sevens 80; three stars 30; three bells 16; three lemons or cherries 10; two cherries 3.
